name: Hyuga
source:
"All you have to do is ask my help, obediently."

Birthplace: Fire Village
Weapon: Bow

In front of his master, he will pretend to be obedient and kind, but displays tendencies of sadistic bullying under the surface.
Hyuga was born into a farming family but became a ninja raised by the Fire Village.
He is burdened with a secret which he cannot tell anyone.

Hyuga's Special Attack: Heavenly Asura Hell Fire

As if he were a berserker, he releases fire arrows so fast that his arms look countless, and showers rain of fire.

[Official in-game description]
